name: appkit-inspector
description: Inspect live native AppKit interfaces in Codex Browser, with explicit local-window and experimental fullscreen options.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect native macOS views in Codex Browser.
interface.longDescription: Connect a Debug AppKit application from Codex, open an authenticated Inspector in the current Codex Browser, click native views, inspect hierarchy and geometry, and copy precise visual feedback back to Codex. External windows are explicit and fullscreen remains experimental.
defaultPrompt: Connect to my running AppKit app and open the inspector.
Inspect the native view I select and locate its source.
Review this AppKit window for layout and accessibility issues.
